material_news_signals.headline: Lions-Bills on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 41-31 win
material_news_signals.description: Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills opened the new Highmark Stadium with a 41-31 victory over the Detroit Lions on Thursday night.
material_news_signals.body_text: the house that josh built open for business new highmark stadium opened its doors for its first official bills home game and josh allen opened the floodgates allen captained his bills to a statement making 85 yard touchdown drive to open the festivities sneaking in from a yard out for the first score in the venue he followed with the first second and fourth td passes in the stadium s one night chronicle racking up four total tds in one half s worth of work looking every bit like a man on a mission just getting started allen s arm was strong and the bills run game was mighty in that opening half allen threw for three scores and 164 yards while rushing for 40 more as lead partner in crime james cook topped 100 yards before halftime head coach joe brady s offense rolled over the lions defense by air and ground piling up 299 total net yards to earn a 27 7 advantage at intermission when detroit opened the second half with a score allen emphatically answered commanding a 75 yard drive with the rebuttal of a 2 yard td run at evening s end allen had 248 yards and three tds on 20 of 31 passing to go with a pair of td runs and 69 yards on the ground it was the bills superstar s fourth game with three plus passing and two plus rushing touchdowns joining kordell stewart as the only players in nfl history with multiple such games a master of ceremonies for a grand opening of the new highmark allen is playing like a quarterback possessed with super bowl aspirations lions are sacrificial lambs just four days after outlasting the saints for an overtime win there was no rest for the weary lions detroit was at the wrong end of a first half blowout credit to dan campbell s squad for failing to go gently into the western new york night but the bills kept their foot on the gas and the lions just looked gassed for much of the game the first half really before seemingly getting a second wind when it was already too late jared goff was sacked on an opening drive three and out and then fumbled twice before a second drive punt by the time goff hit jahmyr gibbs for an 11 yard touchdown the lions were already down 21 points it might just be as simple as the lions being in the wrong place at the wrong time in this one facing a jacked up josh allen and buffalo squad who wouldn t be denied on such a night that s the hope anyway rb battle goes to qb this was a matchup featuring two of the top running backs in the game today but the night belonged to a quarterback over his first 11 carries into the final quarter allen had 72 yards 6 5 per carry two touchdowns and three runs of 10 plus yards perhaps most impressive was his 100 success rate allen s rumbles have guided the bills to success for years and did again on thursday still the cook gibbs matchup wasn t without its merit cook had 101 yards in the first half and 135 with a touchdown for the game robin to allen s batman gibbs had his moments but overall he was held in check 16 carries for 52 yards and this performance could be seen as worrisome in week 1 gibbs had 33 touches five days later he had 22 more why he and goff were still in the game trailing by 17 points with less than three minutes to go is also a valid quandary thursday s loss shouldn t sully the lions high hopes for 2026 but detroit isn t going anywhere without its bell cow gibbs just need to make a decision on how much it can ring that bell rousseau emerging as force through two games 2021 first rounder gregory rousseau has four sacks he s clearly flourishing under new defensive coordinator jim leonhard groot is already halfway to his season high of eight sacks 2022 2024 rousseau had a game best six qb pressures on thursday night per next gen stats as the never quit mantra of the lions led to final stats that didn t really indicate a dominant buffalo defensive performance bradley chubb 1 5 sacks christian benford eight tackles two pass breakups rousseau and the bunch were impressive giving up 31 points two straight weeks looks problematic but this was a blowout in which the losing squad kept swinging holding the lions to a miniscule 66 rushing yards and 4 of 11 on third down is something to hang your helmet on all the more striking was it was done without ed oliver as the standout defensive tackle was ruled out after he injured his hip in pregame but the bills had rousseau who has shot out of the 2026 blocks and is finding his stride in his sixth season detroit d has been dreadful in the season opener the lions escaped with a 31 30 overtime win on thursday detroit was ambushed from the start and never really recovered they were vastly different games but a porous defense has been a two game constant aidan hutchinson one sack four qb pressures has all world talent and the potential to be a defensive player of the year candidate but defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard s unit needs to get better in a hurry it needs to get healthy too but safeties brian branch and kerby joseph are still on the shelf for at least two more games so sheppard must do what he can with what he s got so far that s not nearly been good enough the bills scored touchdowns on six of their nine drives punting twice and ending the game with a kneel over the opening two weeks detroit has ceded a mind spinning 71 points 915 total yards and 63 first downs the latter tied for second most by any team through two games since 1950 not great next gen stats insight for lions bills via nfl pro the buffalo offense featured 13 personnel on 20 plays against the lions its second straight game with 20 plays with three tight ends nfl research joe brady became the first head coach in bills history to start his career 2 0 buffalo has had 20 previous head coaches material_news_signals.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is considered questionable to play Monday against the Giants due to a hip injury, head coach Sean McVay said.
material_news_signals.body_text: there are some injury concerns over another rams star wide receiver puka nacua is questionable to play monday against the giants although nacua is officially listed on the injury report with a hip ailment head coach sean mcvay told reporters nacua is dealing with some groin soreness that is separate from the psoas issue that caused him to miss time during training camp nacua who was a surprise non participant in friday s practice also sat out saturday s session if the two time pro bowler ends up missing the contest or seeing diminished playing time due to his injury los angeles will have to dig deep to find production elsewhere in the passing game nacua was the only rams pass catcher who got going in any way during the team s season opening bludgeoning by the 49ers and even still he was relatively quiet outside of a 41 yard catch nacua hauled in five receptions for 74 yards in week 1 while no one else on the team went over 30 yards davante adams would likely shoulder a large burden of work as matthew stafford s go to guy should nacua end up sitting jordan whittington quad is doubtful to play which leaves konata mumpfield xavier smith cj daniels and tutu atwell available as well as a deep tight end group led by tyler higbee and terrance ferguson it s not an ideal situation for the rams to be dealing with an ailing nacua at the start of a season that began with great expectations l a s early injury hurdles also extend to the defensive side with star acquisition myles garrett on injured reserve following knee surgery still there s plenty of stars to get the job done including defensive lineman aaron donald who plans to make his season debut against new york after ending a two year retirement to rejoin the rams at the end of august it remains to be seen if nacua suits up along with donald for the momentous occasion the rams kick off against the giants on monday at 8 15 p m et

material_news_signals.description: San Francisco tight end George Kittle suggested a nickname for himself and fullback Kyle Juszczyk in their effort to improve the rushing attack for Christian McCaffrey and Kaelon Black.
material_news_signals.body_text: san francisco 49ers tight end george kittle suggested a nickname for himself and fullback kyle juszczyk in their effort to improve the rushing attack for christian mccaffrey and kaelon black it s called dash bros kittle said thursday via the sacramento bee the nickname a slight play on the 2020 49ers nickname yac bros is a recognition to the pre snap dash motion that the niners employed with great aplomb in the week 1 win over the los angeles rams the specific motion involves kittle or juszczyk moving into the backfield from the line of scrimmage before changing his angle or direction right before the snap the motion makes life difficult for defenders they re not my favorite but they re very effective kittle said so i just put my pride aside and just do them i just don t like cutting and running that much i like lining up and hitting people in the face that s kind of what i do the 49ers pre snap motioned the rams to death in week 1 using motions of all varieties on 22 of their 24 designed runs per next gen stats averaging 6 1 yards per carry on those plays in week 2 the dash bros will face a dolphins defense that held the las vegas raiders to 4 1 yards per carry on designed runs in week 1 below the league average of 4 4 yards per carry that number dropped to 3 8 yards per carry when the raiders used motion pre snap the dolphins allowed a 42 2 rushing success rate in week 1 while the 49ers offense posted the league s highest rushing success rate on designed runs 52 0 miami and san francisco kick off from levi s stadium on sunday at 4 25 p m et

material_news_signals.headline: Josh Allen opens Bills' new stadium with 5 TDs in dominant win over Lions
material_news_signals.description: The Buffalo Bills got off to a 21-0 first half lead and never looked back in their first game at the new Highmark Stadium.
material_news_signals.body_text: josh allen and the buffalo bills opened the new highmark stadium with a bang the quarterback accounted for five touchdowns three passing and two rushing as the bills romped over the detroit lions 41 31 in a game that wasn t as close as the score indicated allen noted he was emotional before kickoff as the u s and canadian national anthems played i caught myself taking it all in and understanding how cool what i get to do my job is the coolest in the world allen said thursday night via the associated press it s everything i ever wanted to be the quarterback of an nfl franchise i m just very fortunate to have ended up in buffalo the bills won the coin toss and elected to receive the ball from that moment on it was a stampede allen drove the bills down the field for a score on the opening drive he scored the first touchdown in the new highmark stadium with a 1 yard touchdown run in the first quarter the first touchdown in the old venue then known as rich stadium was scored by jerome barkum of the jets on a 34 yard pass from al woodall per nfl research the last quarterback to score the first touchdown in a new primary home stadium with a rushing touchdown was kordell stewart who opened heinz field in 2001 with an 8 yard rushing touchdown allen was electric completing 20 of his 31 pass attempts for 248 yards and three touchdowns he added 14 rushes for 69 yards and two more rushing scores it marked the fourth game of his career with three or more passing touchdowns and two or more rushing touchdowns stewart who had two in 1997 is the only other player in nfl history to tally multiple such games anytime the ball s in his hands good things happen and yeah love that guy bills coach joe brady said i wanted us to take the ball in this environment and set the tone that was the start that we needed allen dominated whatever detroit threw at him particularly the lions pressure packages detroit blitzed allen on 55 3 of his dropbacks the third highest blitz rate he has faced in a game in the last five seasons and the highest rate by the lions under dc kelvin sheppard the qb completed 12 of 17 attempts for 137 yards and two touchdowns while adding two scramble runs for 10 yards and a touchdown against those blitzes the bills proved an offensive force in every facet the ground game pounded out 203 rushing yards including 135 and a score from james cook and the pass attack put up 248 yards buffalo totaled 446 yards and 34 first downs going 9 of 12 on third downs outside of allen getting sacked twice there were few negative plays to speak of receiver josh palmer scoffed at a question about what makes the bills offense most dangerous after what they ve shown the first two weeks most dangerous i think every position is dangerous he said via tyler dunne of go long we have a dangerous running back room we have a dangerous tight end room we have a dangerous wide receiver room we have an absolutely dangerous quarterback with a dangerous o line so don t ask about dangerous sure the bills put up their trove of points against a lions defense that has looked woeful through two weeks but they also diced up a texans defense last week that is expected to be among the best in the nfl we wondered what the offense would look like with the restrictor plate off under brady turns out it s a supercharged racecar on the autobahn

material_news_signals.headline: Lions-Bills on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 41-31 win
material_news_signals.description: Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills opened the new Highmark Stadium with a 41-31 victory over the Detroit Lions on Thursday night.
material_news_signals.body_text: the house that josh built open for business new highmark stadium opened its doors for its first official bills home game and josh allen opened the floodgates allen captained his bills to a statement making 85 yard touchdown drive to open the festivities sneaking in from a yard out for the first score in the venue he followed with the first second and fourth td passes in the stadium s one night chronicle racking up four total tds in one half s worth of work looking every bit like a man on a mission just getting started allen s arm was strong and the bills run game was mighty in that opening half allen threw for three scores and 164 yards while rushing for 40 more as lead partner in crime james cook topped 100 yards before halftime head coach joe brady s offense rolled over the lions defense by air and ground piling up 299 total net yards to earn a 27 7 advantage at intermission when detroit opened the second half with a score allen emphatically answered commanding a 75 yard drive with the rebuttal of a 2 yard td run at evening s end allen had 248 yards and three tds on 20 of 31 passing to go with a pair of td runs and 69 yards on the ground it was the bills superstar s fourth game with three plus passing and two plus rushing touchdowns joining kordell stewart as the only players in nfl history with multiple such games a master of ceremonies for a grand opening of the new highmark allen is playing like a quarterback possessed with super bowl aspirations lions are sacrificial lambs just four days after outlasting the saints for an overtime win there was no rest for the weary lions detroit was at the wrong end of a first half blowout credit to dan campbell s squad for failing to go gently into the western new york night but the bills kept their foot on the gas and the lions just looked gassed for much of the game the first half really before seemingly getting a second wind when it was already too late jared goff was sacked on an opening drive three and out and then fumbled twice before a second drive punt by the time goff hit jahmyr gibbs for an 11 yard touchdown the lions were already down 21 points it might just be as simple as the lions being in the wrong place at the wrong time in this one facing a jacked up josh allen and buffalo squad who wouldn t be denied on such a night that s the hope anyway rb battle goes to qb this was a matchup featuring two of the top running backs in the game today but the night belonged to a quarterback over his first 11 carries into the final quarter allen had 72 yards 6 5 per carry two touchdowns and three runs of 10 plus yards perhaps most impressive was his 100 success rate allen s rumbles have guided the bills to success for years and did again on thursday still the cook gibbs matchup wasn t without its merit cook had 101 yards in the first half and 135 with a touchdown for the game robin to allen s batman gibbs had his moments but overall he was held in check 16 carries for 52 yards and this performance could be seen as worrisome in week 1 gibbs had 33 touches five days later he had 22 more why he and goff were still in the game trailing by 17 points with less than three minutes to go is also a valid quandary thursday s loss shouldn t sully the lions high hopes for 2026 but detroit isn t going anywhere without its bell cow gibbs just need to make a decision on how much it can ring that bell rousseau emerging as force through two games 2021 first rounder gregory rousseau has four sacks he s clearly flourishing under new defensive coordinator jim leonhard groot is already halfway to his season high of eight sacks 2022 2024 rousseau had a game best six qb pressures on thursday night per next gen stats as the never quit mantra of the lions led to final stats that didn t really indicate a dominant buffalo defensive performance bradley chubb 1 5 sacks christian benford eight tackles two pass breakups rousseau and the bunch were impressive giving up 31 points two straight weeks looks problematic but this was a blowout in which the losing squad kept swinging holding the lions to a miniscule 66 rushing yards and 4 of 11 on third down is something to hang your helmet on all the more striking was it was done without ed oliver as the standout defensive tackle was ruled out after he injured his hip in pregame but the bills had rousseau who has shot out of the 2026 blocks and is finding his stride in his sixth season detroit d has been dreadful in the season opener the lions escaped with a 31 30 overtime win on thursday detroit was ambushed from the start and never really recovered they were vastly different games but a porous defense has been a two game constant aidan hutchinson one sack four qb pressures has all world talent and the potential to be a defensive player of the year candidate but defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard s unit needs to get better in a hurry it needs to get healthy too but safeties brian branch and kerby joseph are still on the shelf for at least two more games so sheppard must do what he can with what he s got so far that s not nearly been good enough the bills scored touchdowns on six of their nine drives punting twice and ending the game with a kneel over the opening two weeks detroit has ceded a mind spinning 71 points 915 total yards and 63 first downs the latter tied for second most by any team through two games since 1950 not great next gen stats insight for lions bills via nfl pro the buffalo offense featured 13 personnel on 20 plays against the lions its second straight game with 20 plays with three tight ends nfl research joe brady became the first head coach in bills history to start his career 2 0 buffalo has had 20 previous head coaches material_news_signals.description: The Vikings will be without their QB1 on Sunday against the Bears. Kyler Murray will miss the divisional matchup due to his concussion suffered in Week 1, said head coach Kevin O'Connell, who added Carson Wentz will get the start.
material_news_signals.body_text: the vikings will take the field sunday without their starting quarterback kyler murray concussion will not play in minnesota s week 2 contest in chicago the quarterback was limited in practice all week and was officially ruled out friday when the team released its injury report carson wentz will get the start instead with j j mccarthy as his backup murray suffered a concussion early in minnesota s week 1 win over green bay during a short scramble which ended with murray sliding to the ground and sustaining a late hit from packers safety javon bullard murray exited the game for further evaluation and was determined to have suffered a concussion placing him in concussion protocol for the week the veteran backup wentz replaced murray and completed 12 of 19 passes for 133 yards and three touchdowns in the comeback victory murray s absence forces the vikings back into familiar territory minnesota spent much of the 2025 season cycling through quarterbacks due to injuries to mccarthy and wentz eventually turning to third stringer max brosmer out of necessity late in the season the instability prompted the vikings to quickly add murray when he became available as a free agent in march but after one week they re once again relying on a backup wentz will fill in for murray again on sunday against a bears team that scored 59 points in their week 1 win over carolina with both teams sitting atop the nfc north standings entering week 2 wentz will aim to keep pace with ben johnson s explosive bears offense while minnesota hopes murray can return in time for week 3 minnesota and chicago kick off sunday from soldier field at 1 p m et

backup has prepared accordingly as usual lock has wandered around the team 39 s practice facility toting a bottle of coconut water often with the same arm in a compression sleeve underneath that loose demeanor though is a quarterback who prepares each week as if he will start just like he has 28 other times in the pros the 29 year old lock is comfortable with his role with the seahawks where he is in the midst of his fourth of eight nfl seasons but make no mistake lock isn 39 t content being sam darnold 39 s benchwarmer 34 i feel like that edge is always there it shouldn 39 t leave you 34 lock coming off the bench last week to complete 16 of 22 passes for 187 yards and a touchdown in a 13 10 season opening win against the new england patriots to stay fresh the no 42 pick in the 2019 nfl draft has gotten creative he keeps a whiteboard close to his bed one of the many surfaces lock uses to diagram plays throughout the week during a typical game week lock estimated he receives roughly 5 10 repetitions with the first team offense macdonald said wednesday that lock will get the vast majority of them this week in practice though third stringer jalen milroe will receive some first team said he 39 s been leaning pretty heavily on darnold who is out with a glute injury but he 39 s also much more prepared to start than when he first came into the league lock has struggled with turnovers at times during his career including when he tossed a league high 15 interceptions in 2020 with the denver broncos seahawks tight end eric saubert played with lock the following season in denver when the qb lost a preseason competition to veteran teddy bridgewater before starting three games all losses saubert said he quickly picked up on the talent that made the missouri product a high draft pick over the past few years saubert thinks lock has developed into more than a quarterback with plenty of tools 34 intangibles are all there like arm strength ability 34 saubert said 34 i think he 39 s more poised smarter i don 39 t want to say more of a pro but we all grow in that way he 39 s just on top of his stuff and knows who he is and plays confidently 34 saubert is not alone the praise for lock over the last week though dates to when the seahawks first acquired him from the broncos in the blockbuster russell wilson trade in 2022 upon lock 39 s arrival in seattle current general manager john schneider and then head coach pete carroll made him feel at home 34 the belief that they had in me was through the roof 34 lock said 34 and it really it warmed my heart a little bit 34 macdonald shares that conviction in lock whom he looks at as a consummate teammate and role model for the team 34 he 39 s got a great balance about him of being a true professional 34 macdonald said 34 but also he 39 s a loose and focused guy he 39 s a warrior in the garden he 39 s all the things that we want from our players 34 the lee 39 s summit mo native has not only endeared himself to plenty of seahawks personnel but also made the pacific northwest a second home lock and his wife natalie have two kids both born during his time with the seahawks simultaneously lock has come up big in a few key moments for the seahawks he was integral to a comeback victory on 34 monday night football 34 against the philadelphia eagles late in the 2023 season throwing the game winning touchdown with 28 seconds to play just as he was in this year 39 s season opener in the process he has won over seattle 39 s locker room which is littered with teammates touting lock as the best second string quarterback in the league 34 drew 39 s the man and everyone backs him and stands by him 34 saubert said 34 we know we can win with him and we all love him as a person too and as a leader 34 there 39 s a reason the broncos at one point looked at lock as their quarterback of the future his makeup and skill set point to being the face of a franchise that is not lock 39 s role these days but at least for one week all eyes are on him he wouldn 39 t want it any other way 34 that 39 s the mentality you have to have we 39 re going to win or lose this game because of how i played today 34 lock said 34 material_news_signals.description: San Francisco tight end George Kittle suggested a nickname for himself and fullback Kyle Juszczyk in their effort to improve the rushing attack for Christian McCaffrey and Kaelon Black.
material_news_signals.body_text: san francisco 49ers tight end george kittle suggested a nickname for himself and fullback kyle juszczyk in their effort to improve the rushing attack for christian mccaffrey and kaelon black it s called dash bros kittle said thursday via the sacramento bee the nickname a slight play on the 2020 49ers nickname yac bros is a recognition to the pre snap dash motion that the niners employed with great aplomb in the week 1 win over the los angeles rams the specific motion involves kittle or juszczyk moving into the backfield from the line of scrimmage before changing his angle or direction right before the snap the motion makes life difficult for defenders they re not my favorite but they re very effective kittle said so i just put my pride aside and just do them i just don t like cutting and running that much i like lining up and hitting people in the face that s kind of what i do the 49ers pre snap motioned the rams to death in week 1 using motions of all varieties on 22 of their 24 designed runs per next gen stats averaging 6 1 yards per carry on those plays in week 2 the dash bros will face a dolphins defense that held the las vegas raiders to 4 1 yards per carry on designed runs in week 1 below the league average of 4 4 yards per carry that number dropped to 3 8 yards per carry when the raiders used motion pre snap the dolphins allowed a 42 2 rushing success rate in week 1 while the 49ers offense posted the league s highest rushing success rate on designed runs 52 0 miami and san francisco kick off from levi s stadium on sunday at 4 25 p m et
